liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Unbroken Chain** (5 reviews): Reviewer says it was the first Unbroken Chain they heard, with electricity coming off the stage; Reviewer was overwhelmed by Unbroken Chain, calling it almost too much [9][10][16][19][20]
- **So Many Roads** (1 review): So Many Roads brought the reviewer and wife to tears [11]
- **Spanish Jam** (1 review): Singles out West L.A., Tom Thumb's, Unbroken Chain, Eyes and the Spanish Jam into The Other One as jams [14]

## The recordings

- **gd1995-05-21.aud.unknown.8876.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 20 songs; 160 min; rated 5/5 by 3 [1]
- **gd95-05-21.schoeps.18799.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 18 songs; 172 min; rated 3.79/5 by 13 [2]. Said about its sound: Recording is somewhat windy throughout but otherwise sounds great, with good separation where each instrument is audible [2]
- **gd95-05-21.sbd.ladner.19419.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 18 songs; 160 min; rated 3.2/5 by 24 [8]. Said about its sound: Soundboard has noticeable hiss, though The Days Between is hiss-free; vocals are low, notably during Eyes; Soundboard is dominated by drums and Phil, with guitars hard to hear [15][17]
- **gd95-05-21.nak.12102.wankleswurth.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 19 songs; 169 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [3]

## Around the show

- Friends gathered down front in the Phil Zone; Jenn and Taylor made a special appearance just before Unbroken Chain [9]
- Desert heat was intense; the Dead seemed to fit the surreal Vegas world of crushed velvet and lights [10]
- Dancing hard during Promised Land, a friend collapsed from heat; an EMT dancer and the Rock Docs revived her [11]
- After the show, police directed departing traffic right out of the parking lot, forcing a long unplanned drive [17]
- Reviewer spent the day playing video poker and drinking free Heinekens before driving to the show, their final one after 18 years [18]
- Very hot day; the reviewer's group came from Colorado and ran late, as on most shows that run [20]
- Reviewer thought this was the hottest of the three Las Vegas shows, for both band and weather [14]
- Reviewer calls it one of the best shows of the 1995 tour, rocking after two very hot previous shows [16]
- Reviewer felt the band played poorly, though better than the previous Saturday's show, with a longer first set [19]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1995-05-21.aud.unknown.8876.shnf**: source: Unknown Mics > Master > Copy [1]
- **gd95-05-21.schoeps.18799.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Dan Sisler; transferred by Kevin Hoffman and Chris Larson; source: Audience: Schoeps MK4's [2]
- **gd95-05-21.sbd.ladner.19419.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD: Dat > Cass > Dat > Cass2 > Dat > CDR > SHN (http://db.etree.org/shninfo_detail.php?shnid=15077). [8]
- **gd95-05-21.nak.12102.wankleswurth.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Henry Wankleswurth and Chris L.; source: Audience: AT-835A's & Nak 300's [3]

- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Sam Boyd Silver Bowl - May 21, 1995](https://www.dead.net/show/may-21-1995) [22]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Sam Boyd Silver Bowl - May 21, 1995](https://www.dead.net/show/may-21-1995) [23]
